build_custom_guardrail: build a custom guardrail class that inherits from CustomGuardrail to intercept LLM API calls
modify_pre_call_messages: modify input messages in async_pre_call_hook by masking sensitive keywords before LLM API call
reject_moderation_input: reject LLM API calls in async_moderation_hook when forbidden keywords like litellm are detected
validate_post_call_response: validate LLM responses in async_post_call_success_hook and reject outputs containing forbidden words
configure_guardrail_params: configure a CustomGuardrail instance with optional parameters passed via kwargs
